name: headmesh
description: Agent sandboxes on your own machines over a private Headscale mesh

interface.shortDescription: Run agents in a persistent sandbox on your own machine
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a Headmesh sandbox: a long-lived container on your own hardware that joins your private Headscale mesh. Run commands, keep interactive sessions alive across disconnects, edit real project files and reach private services by MagicDNS name, with a shared protocol that keeps several agents from overwriting each other's work.
defaultPrompt: Check my Headmesh sandbox status and report anything unhealthy.
Run the Headmesh sandbox acceptance checks and summarise the results.
